    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    baseline = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)), None)

        return out

            top = max(0, baseline - height)

            for r in range(top + 1, baseline):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
